      table.insert(out, string.format('%s | %s pos=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) size=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)', p:GetFullName():gsub('Workspace.SpawnTown.', ''), p.ClassName, pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z, p.Size.X, p.Size.Y, p.Size.Z))
    end
  end
end

for _, z in ipairs({-700, -740, -760, -780, -820, -900}) do
